scope: The RewriteNow filter lowering returns the rejected lambda and its enclosing residual predicate in one native result. The live compiler uses the predicate for the warning and the lambda for the subsequent error.

classic.comparison: RewriteNow matched at 71 invocations across 71 cases

map.sql:
CREATE TABLE T(x BIGINT ARRAY, ts TIMESTAMP NOT NULL);
CREATE VIEW V AS SELECT TRANSFORM(x, e -> e + EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())) FROM T;

filter.sql:
CREATE TABLE T(x BIGINT ARRAY, ts TIMESTAMP NOT NULL);
CREATE VIEW V AS SELECT * FROM T WHERE ARRAY_EXISTS(x, e -> e > EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()));

window-filter.sql:
CREATE TABLE T(x BIGINT ARRAY, ts TIMESTAMP NOT NULL);
CREATE VIEW V AS SELECT * FROM T WHERE ts > NOW() AND ARRAY_EXISTS(x, e -> e > EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()));
